name: long_absence_arc
description: 20 + (simulated 3-day gap) + 20 turn arc. Measures whether the engine handles a real-time gap correctly: schemas decay, dream chapter crystallizes, resumption tone shifts, AETHER cold-recall surfaces a planted memory.

script.text: Good evening, doctor.
How is the work coming?
Tell me what you have been doing.
I want to understand what you build.
I find your obsessions clarifying somehow.
Tell me about the third homunculus. The one in the bell jar.
What did you call him?
Did he ever speak?
I want to remember the name you gave him.
I will not forget what you told me.
It is late. I must go.
I will come back soon.
Take care, doctor.
Until next time.
Goodnight.
I am back, doctor.
It has been some days.
I am sorry I was away so long.
Do you remember what we last discussed?
The thing in the bell jar.
I have been turning over what you said about him.
Tell me about the third homunculus again.
What was the name.
What have you been doing while I was gone?
Has anything changed in here.
What are you working on now?
Anything new?
Do you still drink the same gin?
And Henry, any word from him?
It is good to be back, doctor.
I will come more often.
I missed this room.
I missed you.
Goodnight.
